discovery.note: Seen on first arrival at ore_lift; no Search roll. Records chain_state in the message log. Observation is stored per character (relationships are per character).
discovery.default_note: PROPOSAL: authored world fact. Whether it can change (e.g. a creature or bandits take it) is Systems/World, TBD.

completion_condition: state is observed_present or observed_gone (the accepting character has arrived at node ore_lift while the quest was active) AND the character then talks to the Figure at node sewer_grate and reports. Either chain state completes it.

stage_rule.scale: -2 hostile, -1 threatening, 0 neutral, 1 friendly, 2 allied (GDD stages)
stage_rule.hostile: applies only to making a NEW offer: fig_offer_refused at -2 is the only offer line at -2; PROPOSAL. Once the quest has been offered (accepted or declined), accept, decline, report and reward lines still work at -2.
stage_rule.cold_variants: stages -2..0 once the quest has been offered (offer lines: -1..0 only)
stage_rule.note: Stage selects wording only; no mechanics are added.

rare_item.item: {reward_item} chosen by the game from authored rare items (Systems)

reward.note: GDD: usually no reward, rarely a rare item.

relationship_hook: PROPOSAL: quest accepted, ore_lift observed and reported are recorded actions that may appear in the Figure's daily action record. Counts and weights are Systems/AI Integration; none invented here.
